entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I'd like to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the account?
Sure, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF77819-P.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here... the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 20th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's really just a preference. It works fine, but it's not what I was expecting. Now, I know I've had it for almost a month, and I'm a bit worried it's too late. I figured there would be a strict policy on worn items because of hygiene and sanitation reasons.
I understand your concern about the timing and hygiene. Let me just double-check the return policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thanks. I was hoping maybe we could work something out, like a partial credit if a full refund isn't possible.
Okay, Sarah, thanks for your patience. I've just reviewed our policy, and you're actually unfortunately outside the return window. VeloFit offers a 10-day return period on all our products.
Oh, really? 10 days? I was sure it would be much shorter. That's great news!

Yes, absolutely. Since you received it only 26 days ago, we can definitely process a full refund for you. I've just initiated the return on my end. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack it back in the original box and drop it at any post office.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much, David. I appreciate your help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
